info.name: Household Expenses API
info.description:
Every route of the API under `/api/v1`, for manual testing.

1. Import this collection and `local.postman_environment.json`, then select the **Household Expenses — local** environment.
2. Set `AUTH_TEST_MODE=true` in `.env` so every emailed code is `000000` and Google accepts `test:<email>`. Otherwise read the code in `storage/logs/laravel.log`.
3. Requests run in mobile (token) mode: they send `device_id`, and the collection script stores `token` and `pending_sign_in` from the answers.

Errors look like `{"error": {"code": "..."}}`. Full contracts: `specs/<NNN>-<feature>/contract.md`.

request.description:
Checks that the API answers. Returns `200 {"data": {"status": "ok"}}`.

**Auth:** none  
**Throttle:** 60/min

**Errors:** `429 request.throttled`

item.name: Accounts (spec 002)
item.description: Sign-up, sign-in, password reset, Google and two-step sign-in. Contract: `specs/002-accounts/contract.md`.

request.description:
Creates an unconfirmed account and emails a 6-digit code (valid 15 min). Returns `202`, no body. `phone` and `locale` are optional.

**Auth:** none  
**Throttle:** email routes

**Errors:** `409 email.taken`, `422 validation.failed`

Emails a new sign-up code if the account is unconfirmed. Returns `202` for any address.

**Auth:** none  
**Throttle:** email routes

**Errors:** `422 validation.failed`

Confirms the address with the emailed code and signs in. Returns a Session with a `token`.

**Auth:** none  
**Throttle:** sign-in routes

**Errors:** `422 code.invalid`, `422 validation.failed`

Signs in with email and password. Returns `signed_in` with a `token`, or `code_required` with a `pending_sign_in` when two-step sign-in is on (then call **Two-step sign-in / Confirm code**).

**Auth:** none  
**Throttle:** sign-in routes

**Errors:** `401 auth.invalid_credentials`, `403 auth.email_unconfirmed`, `429 auth.password_locked`, `422 validation.failed`

Emails a reset code to a confirmed account. Returns `202` for any address.

**Auth:** none  
**Throttle:** email routes

**Errors:** `422 validation.failed`

Sets `new_password` with the emailed code. Returns `204` and ends every token and web session of the account. Copy `new_password` into `password` before signing in again.

**Auth:** none  
**Throttle:** sign-in routes

**Errors:** `422 code.invalid`, `422 validation.failed`

Signs in, or signs up on first use, with a Google ID token. With `AUTH_TEST_MODE=true`, `test:<email>` is accepted. `terms_version` is needed only on the first sign-in; `phone` and `locale` are used only then.

**Auth:** none  
**Throttle:** sign-in routes

**Errors:** `401 auth.google_invalid`, `503 auth.google_unavailable`, `409 auth.google_email_conflict`, `422 auth.terms_required`, `422 validation.failed`

Finishes a sign-in that answered `code_required`, with `pending_sign_in` (stored automatically) and the emailed code. Returns a Session. The 5th wrong code ends the sign-in; it expires after 10 min.

**Auth:** none  
**Throttle:** sign-in routes

**Errors:** `422 code.invalid`, `401 auth.pending_invalid`, `422 validation.failed`

Emails a new two-step code; the 10 minutes and the try count restart. Returns `202`.

**Auth:** none  
**Throttle:** email routes

**Errors:** `401 auth.pending_invalid`

Returns the signed-in account.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}`  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`

Turns two-step sign-in on. Returns `204`; open sessions keep working.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}`  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `409 two_factor.already_enabled`, `401 auth.unauthenticated`

Emails the code needed to turn two-step sign-in off. Returns `202`.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}`  
**Throttle:** email routes

**Errors:** `409 two_factor.not_enabled`, `401 auth.unauthenticated`

Turns two-step sign-in off with the emailed disable code. Returns `204`.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}`  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `409 two_factor.not_enabled`, `422 code.invalid`, `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `422 validation.failed`

Ends the current token only. Returns `204`. The stored `token` stops working.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}`  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`

Your household as a one-item list, or an empty list. Cursor pagination (`?cursor=`).

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`

Creates a household with you as `owner`. It has no book: create one with **Books / Create the household book**. Stores `household_id`.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** creations (10 per minute per account, shared with books)

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `422 household.limit_reached`, `422 validation.failed`, `429 request.throttled`

Your household, with your role.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 household.not_found`

Owner only. An empty body changes nothing.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 household.not_found`, `403 household.forbidden`, `422 validation.failed`

Owner only. Every member leaves it and its book is deleted too (soft delete). Returns `204`.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 household.not_found`, `403 household.forbidden`

Members with account id, name and role: owners first, then by date joined. Cursor pagination.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 household.not_found`

Your personal books and your household's book, oldest first, with `can_manage`. Cursor pagination.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`

Creates a personal book (at most 5). `currency` defaults to TND and can never change; `timezone` defaults to Africa/Tunis. Stores `book_id`.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** creations (10 per minute per account, shared with households)

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `422 validation.failed`, `422 book.limit_reached`, `429 request.throttled`

Owner only: creates the one book of the household in `household_id`. Stores `book_id`.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** creations (10 per minute per account, shared with households)

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `422 validation.failed` (incl. `household_id.not_found`), `403 household.forbidden`, `422 book.household_has_book`, `429 request.throttled`

A book you can reach: yours, or your household's.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 book.not_found`

Renames the book and/or changes its timezone, when `can_manage` is true. `currency` and `household_id` are refused.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 book.not_found`, `403 book.forbidden`, `422 validation.failed`

item.name: Invitations and members (spec 004)
item.description: Email and QR invitations, removing a member, leaving. Contract: `specs/004-invitations/contract.md`.

request.description:
Owner only. Invites an address to join as `member` and queues a notice email in your language (no link, no token). Same answer whether or not an account exists for the address. Valid 7 days. Stores `invitation_id`.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** 20 invitations per household per rolling 24 hours

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 household.not_found`, `403 household.forbidden`, `422 validation.failed`, `422 invitation.self`, `422 invitation.already_member`, `422 invitation.already_pending`, `422 household.member_limit`, `422 invitation.limit_reached`, `429 request.throttled`

Owner only. The household's pending invitations (not answered, not cancelled, not expired), oldest first. Cursor pagination.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 household.not_found`, `403 household.forbidden`

Owner only. Cancels a pending invitation. No email is sent.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 household.not_found`, `403 household.forbidden`, `404 invitation.not_found`

The pending invitations sent to your confirmed account email, in any letter case. Empty while your email is not confirmed. Stores the first one's id in `invitation_id`.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`

Joins the household as `member` and answers the household. The invitation stays pending when you are refused for `already_joined` or `member_limit`.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 invitation.not_found`, `422 household.already_joined`, `422 household.member_limit`

Declines a pending invitation sent to you.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 invitation.not_found`

Owner only. Creates a QR invitation that works once for 10 minutes and cancels the previous unused one. The `token` is shown only here; the app draws it as a QR code. Stores `qr_token`.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** creations (10 per minute per account, shared with households and books)

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `429 request.throttled`, `404 household.not_found`, `403 household.forbidden`, `422 household.member_limit`

Shows the household and the inviter of a scanned QR code. Changes nothing. Needs a confirmed email.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** household-qr (10 per minute per account, shared with joining)

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `429 request.throttled`, `422 validation.failed`, `404 invitation.not_found`

item.name: Join with a scanned QR code

request.description:
Joins the household of a scanned QR code as `member`; the code then stops working. Needs a confirmed email.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** household-qr (10 per minute per account, shared with preview)

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `429 request.throttled`, `422 validation.failed`, `404 invitation.not_found`, `422 household.already_joined`, `422 household.member_limit`

Owner only. Removes a member (account id from the members list). They lose access to the household and its book at once.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 household.not_found`, `403 household.forbidden`, `404 member.not_found`, `422 household.owner_cannot_leave`

Member only. Leaves the household and loses access to it and its book at once. The owner deletes the household instead.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 household.not_found`, `422 household.owner_cannot_leave`

The whole category tree, the same for every account: top categories → `groups` → `leaves`, in display order. Each node has `code`, `translation_key`, `emoji` and `retired`; tops add `type`, leaves add `is_other`. No names: the app translates `translation_key`. Not paginated. Run `php artisan ledger:sync-categories` once after `migrate`, or the list is empty.

The answer carries an `ETag`. Send it back as `If-None-Match` to get `304` with no body while the list is unchanged.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session)  
**Throttle:** 60 requests a minute per account

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `429 request.throttled`

item.name: Transactions (spec 006)
item.description: Entries (the `transactions` of a book), recurring rules and suggestions for "Other" names. Every route is nested under a book: set `book_id` first (create a book in **Books and households**). Amounts are integers in the book currency's minor unit (TND: millimes). Full contract: `specs/006-transactions/contract.md`.

request.description:
The book's entries, newest date first, 25 per page (`?cursor=`). Filters, all optional and combined: `from`, `to` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive), `category` (a top, group or leaf code), `type` (`expense`, `income`, `saving`), `author` (an account id). Enable the ones you need.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session); you must own the personal book or be a live member of its household  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 book.not_found`, `422 validation.failed` (`from.date_format`, `to.after_or_equal`, `category.not_found`, `type.in`, `author.uuid`)

Records an expense, income or saving: the type comes from the leaf category. `id` is optional: a UUID made by the client, so a retried request answers the stored entry with `200` instead of a duplicate. `other_name` is required on an "Other" leaf only. Stores `transaction_id`.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session); you must own the personal book or be a live member of its household  
**Throttle:** ledger-writes (60 writes per minute per account, entries and rules together)

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 book.not_found`, `409 transaction.id_conflict`, `422 validation.failed` (`amount.*`, `date.*`, `category.not_found`, `category.not_leaf`, `category.retired`, `other_name.required`, `other_name.prohibited`, `comment.max`, `id.uuid`), `429 request.throttled`

exec: if ((pm.response.code === 200 || pm.response.code === 201) && body.data && body.data.id) { pm.environment.set('transaction_id', body.data.id); }

request.description:
Same as **Record an entry**, on an "Other" leaf: `other_name` (1–60 characters) is required. Stores `transaction_id`.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session); you must own the personal book or be a live member of its household  
**Throttle:** ledger-writes (60 writes per minute per account, entries and rules together)

**Errors:** as **Record an entry**

One entry, with who recorded and last edited it.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session); you must own the personal book or be a live member of its household  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 book.not_found`, `404 transaction.not_found`

Changes only the fields sent: `amount`, `date`, `category`, `other_name`, `comment`. Any member may edit any entry of the book. Moving to an "Other" leaf needs `other_name`; moving away clears it.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session); you must own the personal book or be a live member of its household  
**Throttle:** ledger-writes (60 writes per minute per account, entries and rules together)

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 book.not_found`, `404 transaction.not_found`, `422 validation.failed`, `429 request.throttled`

Deletes the entry (kept in the database, soft-deleted). It then answers `404`. An entry made by a recurring rule is never made again.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session); you must own the personal book or be a live member of its household  
**Throttle:** ledger-writes (60 writes per minute per account, entries and rules together)

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 book.not_found`, `404 transaction.not_found`, `429 request.throttled`

Up to 10 names already typed in this book for an "Other" leaf, most used first, then most recent. Names differing only in letter case count as one.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session); you must own the personal book or be a live member of its household  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 book.not_found`, `422 validation.failed` (`category.required`, `category.not_found`, `category.not_other`)

The book's recurring rules, next date first (finished rules last), 25 per page (`?cursor=`).

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session); you must own the personal book or be a live member of its household  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 book.not_found`

Records the same entry on a schedule: `frequency` `weekly`, `monthly` or `yearly`, every `interval` (1–12, default 1), from `starts_on` (up to 1 year back or ahead) until the optional `ends_on`. A start in the past creates the entries due up to today at once. The hourly scheduler then records each entry on its date, in the book's timezone. Stores `recurring_rule_id`.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session); you must own the personal book or be a live member of its household  
**Throttle:** ledger-writes (60 writes per minute per account, entries and rules together)

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 book.not_found`, `422 recurring_rule.limit_reached` (100 per book), `422 validation.failed` (`frequency.in`, `interval.*`, `starts_on.*`, `ends_on.after_or_equal`, and the entry field codes), `429 request.throttled`

One rule, with `next_date` (`null` once it has ended).

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session); you must own the personal book or be a live member of its household  
**Throttle:** none

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 book.not_found`, `404 recurring_rule.not_found`

Changes only the fields sent. Entries already made stay as they are; a new schedule applies from today.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session); you must own the personal book or be a live member of its household  
**Throttle:** ledger-writes (60 writes per minute per account, entries and rules together)

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 book.not_found`, `404 recurring_rule.not_found`, `422 validation.failed`, `429 request.throttled`

Stops the rule (soft-deleted). The entries it made stay.

**Auth:** signed in (bearer token or web session); you must own the personal book or be a live member of its household  
**Throttle:** ledger-writes (60 writes per minute per account, entries and rules together)

**Errors:** `401 auth.unauthenticated`, `404 book.not_found`, `404 recurring_rule.not_found`, `429 request.throttled`
